California buyers: the South Coast AQMD (Rules 1121 and 1146.2) and the Bay Area AQMD require low-NOx certified gas water heaters. This standard model is not sold as an Ultra Low NOx unit, so please confirm it meets your local air district rules before ordering. Contact us if you need help.

The RUUD PRO+G50-40N-RU62 is a 50 gallon residential natural gas tank water heater with a 40,000 Btu/h input. It is an atmospheric vent model that connects to a 3" or 4" B-vent, so it suits homes that already have a conventional vertical vent and are replacing a standard gas tank heater. It has 3/4" MIP hot and cold water connections and a 1/2" gas inlet. The tank is 21-1/2" in diameter and 59-1/4" tall, and the heater is rated for installation up to 10,100 ft.

Key Features

  • 50 gallon storage tank with a 40,000 Btu/h natural gas burner
  • Atmospheric venting through 3" or 4" B-vent
  • 3/4" MIP hot and cold water connections
  • 1/2" gas inlet
  • Tank 21-1/2" in diameter and 59-1/4" tall
  • Rated for elevations up to 10,100 ft

Applications

  • Replacement of an existing atmospheric vent gas tank water heater
  • Single-family homes with a B-vent already in place
  • Utility rooms, basements and garages with room for a tall tank

Before You Order

  • Fuel: this model is built for natural gas. Natural gas and propane models are not interchangeable.
  • Gas line: the inlet is 1/2"; the supply line must be sized for 40,000 Btu/h.
  • Venting: atmospheric, 3" or 4" B-vent. It cannot be vented through a side wall with plastic pipe and it needs adequate combustion air.
  • Electrical supply: confirm in the installation manual whether a power connection is required.
  • Dimensions: 21-1/2" diameter and 59-1/4" tall. Measure the space, including the draft hood and vent connector above the tank.
  • Local rules: check low-NOx requirements and permit rules for your area before ordering.

The Rheem GHE100SU-200NG is a 100 gallon Triton SU heavy duty commercial natural gas water heater with a 200,000 Btu/h input. The Rheem ELD80-D is an 80 gallon light duty commercial electric water heater with a terminal block and triple-rated elements: 3.4 kW at 208 V, 4.5 kW at 240 V or 6 kW at 277 V. One model therefore covers the three common commercial supply voltages. It is a storage water heater for offices, retail spaces, restaurants and multifamily buildings that need more capacity than a residential electric unit. The glass-lined steel tank is 23-3/4" in diameter and 59-5/8" tall, with 3/4" water connections and a maximum temperature setting of 180°F.

  • Triple-rated elements: 3.4 kW at 208 V, 4.5 kW at 240 V, 6 kW at 277 V

  • 3/4" water connections
  • Maximum water temperature setting of 180°F
  • Tank 23-3/4" in diameter and 59-5/8" tall

Applications

  • Offices and retail spaces
  • Restaurants and small food service
  • Multifamily buildings and other light commercial hot water loads

  • Water connections: 3/4".
